title: Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators (Demo)
native_title: デジタル・ピンボール 「ラスト・グラディエーターズ」
overview:
A trial version of Digital Pinball: Last Gladiators, a realistic pinball simulation from KAZe for one player.

The demo lets you play the Gladiators table, a Roman arena-themed machine, for a limited time. Shoot the ball at targets, lanes, ramps and bumpers to build your score, and pick a bonus before each ball is launched. Clear the table's bonus rounds to work toward the Gladiator Show finale.

The full game offers four tables: Gladiators, Knight of the Roses, Dragon Showdown and Warlock.
